{{Top|leg}}
'''The Paladin''' was one of the main characters in [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr's]] play, ''[[The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma]]''. He and the Soldier were once comrades before the Soldier left to pursue other venues. When [[Vosdia Nooma]], [[Baron/Legends|baron]] of the town of [[Yusk]], struggled with internal and external strife, the Paladin offered the use of a personal army to protect himself and his people from rebelling outlying farmers stirred up by the Soldier; Nooma refused and the Paladin left.

The Paladin was played by [[Fosin Dreed]].
